basis: An investment adviser is a financial institution under GLBA, and every client is an individual using the service for personal and family purposes. obligation: Interagency Guidelines Establishing Information Security Standards
citation: 12 CFR 30 App. B; 12 CFR 208 App. D-2 and 225 App. F; 12 CFR 364 App. B
basis: The Guidelines cover banks and bank holding companies. This is a sole proprietorship with no charter, and no bank passes them down by contract: the custodian is a broker-dealer and the adviser is not its service provider

The adviser holds no New York license or registration

248.30(d)(3) covers investment advisers registered with the SEC. With about $19 million under management and no fund clients, Advisers Act section 203A(a)(1) bars SEC registration, and the adviser is registered with Florida instead

obligation: SEC Regulation S-ID (Identity Theft Red Flags)
basis: Covers advisers registered or required to be registered with the SEC; same registration status as N52-R05

obligation: NAIC Insurance Data Security Model Law #668
basis: The adviser holds no insurance license and sells no insurance

basis: The adviser is not a credit union
